findings.claim: The assessment states the i18n requirement as 19 locales, contradicting the project constraint of 18 locale files.
findings.evidence: Constraint Check says "any new UI string needs `types.ts` first, then all 19 locales" and Open Question 3 says "Does it need a UI toggle (→ 19 locales)", but `constraints` states: "New i18n keys must be added to `types.ts` first and defined in all 18 locale files under `apps/web/src/i18n/locales/*.ts`."
findings.suggested_fix: Correct both instances to 18 locales (or verify the actual count against `apps/web/src/i18n/locales/` and cite it), so downstream scoping of UI-string work uses the right multiplier.

findings.claim: Goal 4 is analyzed as a standalone generic export plugin, ignoring that the goal text explicitly requires the export to use the hybrid architecture skill, making Goal 4 dependent on Goal 3's unresolved scope.
findings.evidence: Goal 4 reads: "Build a custom plugin or Open-Design-native extension that exports projects using the hybrid architecture skill." The Goal 4 section discusses `od-react-export` precedent, atom limitations, and EXPORT_FORMATS without once mentioning the hybrid architecture skills, and Open Question 6 ("Export target — prompt-only plugin … vs. first-party atom + contract + CLI") frames the choice independently of Open Question 1 ("Goal 3 scope — install 39 skills / invoke `knowme-builder` / port profiles?"). Each Goal 3 reading implies a different Goal 4 deliverable.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an explicit dependency finding: Goal 4's export shape cannot be decided until Goal 3's interpretation is resolved, and state which Goal 4 option pairs with each Goal 3 reading.

findings.claim: Goal 2's purpose clause — integration "with ejected code projects" — receives no gap analysis; the assessment covers only install mechanics.
findings.evidence: Goal 2 reads: "Detect or install the Prometheus skill system … so work done here integrates with ejected code projects." The word "ejected" appears nowhere in the artifact; the Goal 2 section and SPEC GAP SUMMARY address only single-skill vs. pack install, leaving the ejected-code integration path (what ejection means in this codebase, whether an eject/export path exists for the pack to hook into) unassessed.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a finding on whether any code-ejection/export path exists in the daemon or web app that installed skills integrate with, or mark it UNKNOWN with an explicit open question for analyze.

findings.claim: The claim that the gate effect "re-fires on every render where the condition holds" contradicts the quoted dependency array.
findings.evidence: The quoted code ends with `}, [amrLoggedIn, view]);` — a `useEffect` with a two-element deps array re-fires only when `amrLoggedIn` or `view` changes, not on every render.
findings.suggested_fix: Reword to "re-fires whenever `amrLoggedIn` or `view` changes while the condition holds" so the mechanism description matches the evidence.

findings.claim: The "no offline-mode flag exists" finding is scoped to three source trees and does not rule out an existing flag elsewhere.
findings.evidence: "Grep for `OD_OFFLINE|offlineMode|localOnlyMode|disableCloud|skipSignIn|SELF_HOST` across `apps/daemon/src`, `apps/web/src`, `apps/packaged/src` returns zero hits" — `apps/desktop` (present in the file tree) and `packages/` were not searched, and desktop is the packaged runtime where such a flag would plausibly live.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the grep to `apps/desktop` and `packages/` (or state the exclusion explicitly) before asserting no flag exists.
